result: Jack worked alone at his table, so there was no arguing about the animal. He chose a fish with "a big tail fin" and a clear outline. He began with the body, calling out, "Nose on the left, tail fin on the right." The turn came when the top was done but "the belly and tail didn't take," so he redid the bottom line. Soon "Belly and tail are going down now," and he announced, "Fish is coming together!" With time nearly gone, he tied the belly into the nose, laid the lower tail fin, and cheered, "Nice work, everyone." In the final minutes he re-laid the nose and top line so the start domino would go down. In the end, 10 of 51 dominoes fell. The judges guessed a curved line, an arc, or a hook, not a fish.
